boss:1.text: Bloaters are the fourth, rarest, and one of the most dangerous stages of the infected in The Last of Us and The Last of Us Part II. They take a few years to develop and reach this stage after exposure to the Cordyceps brain infection. Bloaters are incredibly strong and physically imposing infected that are covered in thick fungus that effectively acts as armor plates.

easter-egg:1.text: At the start of the "Hometown" chapter, in Sarah's room, one of the posters on the wall depict members of the Naughty Dog development team, the developers of The Last of Us series.

easter-egg:2.text: A film series whose poster can be initially seen in Sarah's room, but appears all over the game in several different variations including posters, billboard advertisements, and DVD cases. The films are a parody of, a vampire-themed romance film series based on the .

easter-egg:3.text: During the chapter "Hometown", when the player goes down to the living room of Joel and Sarah's house, there is a PlayStation 3 console on the shelf under the television set. Another one is found in Larry's TV & Stereo, an electronics store Ellie passes through after escaping David into the blizzard during the "Lakeside Resort" chapter.

easter-egg:4.text: Throughout the game, including Left Behind, there are a number of newspapers on the ground called The Daily Metro with a headline stating "Uncharted 13: A Lush Movie — as Drake." Drake refers to Nathan Drake from the Uncharted series, also developed by Naughty Dog.

easter-egg:5.text: One of the houses that Bill, Joel and Ellie travel through looks almost identical to the layout of the house from the beginning of the 2012 episodic video game by .

easter-egg:6.text: When Ellie learns to whistle during the "Pittsburgh" chapter, the tune she whistles is vaguely similar to the "Nate's Theme" track from the Uncharted series.

easter-egg:7.text: When Joel and Ellie are separated in the basement of the Hotel Grand, Joel must find a keycard to escape. The owner of the keycard is named Jack Sullivinsky, a surname that is strikingly close to Victor Sullivan's, Drake's companion from the Uncharted series.

easter-egg:8.text: Near the mob attack note, the player can find a poster about employee rights. This poster is made by the JAK Company, which is a reference to the Jak and Daxter series, also developed by Naughty Dog. The poster also includes a phone number, 1-800-555-TLOU, and the URL for The Last of Us website.

easter-egg:9.text: Right after meeting Henry and Sam, Joel will be able to enter a child's room in Serenity Apartments. Jak and Daxter plush toys can be found on a dresser and a Nathan Drake plush toy can be found on the bed.

easter-egg:10.text: Joel can find a blue mousepad with the Naughty Dog logo across it on computer desks in several locations. In Pittsburgh, there is one in the same shiv room of Serenity Apartments, as well as Spenzür Architecture, the office Henry and Sam have taken temporary residence in. There is also one in a second-story bedroom of the ranch house during "Tommy's Dam".

easter-egg:11.text: A restaurant bar found near the bridge in Pittsburgh, O'Sullivan's Pub, bears a striking resemblance to the pub from the opening of Uncharted 3: Drake's Deception. The name "O'Sullivan's" is also a reference to Victor Sullivan.

easter-egg:12.text: A coffee cart called "Java Jak" can be found right outside the O'Sullivan's Irish Pub in Pittsburgh. This is a reference to the Jak and Daxter series. Another one can be found during the chapter "Fun and Games" of Left Behind, outside of Raja's Arcade while Ellie and Riley explore the Liberty Gardens mall.

easter-egg:13.text: Right after escaping the sewers, the group find "Warning: Infected inside, do not open" written on the wall. This is a reference to the first episode of the TV adaptation of, in which the protagonist finds a sign saying "Don't open, dead inside" on a door.

easter-egg:14.text: After escaping from David during the "Lakeside Resort" chapter, Ellie will enter a pet store called "Faithful Dog". This is a reference to Naughty Dog.

easter-egg:15.text: After Ellie drops down into the kitchen of Todd's Steakhouse, move into a back office where there will be a notice board. Here, a piece of paper can be seen which displays the phurba dagger from Uncharted 2: Among Thieves.

easter-egg:16.text: During the chapter "Bus Depot", Joel can find an NDI sticker on the wall of a bathroom stall in the Logan James Bus Station, which is a reference to Naughty Dog. The sticker is also identical to the ones seen in Uncharted 3: Drake's Deception.

easter-egg:17.text: In the Firefly's lab at Saint Mary's Hospital, there are eye charts with messages that can be read from left to right. One of them says "RUN YOU R NEARLY THERE DON'T QUIT!!"

easter-egg:18.text: During the chapter "Mallrats" of Left Behind, in the Spooky Town Costume Emporium in the Liberty Gardens mall, Ellie can find packaged Nathan Drake costumes from Uncharted 2: Among Thieves.

easter-egg:19.text: During the chapter "Fun and Games", Ellie and Riley come across an arcade named "Raja's Arcade" in the Liberty Gardens mall. The name "Raja" is a reference to the siblings Eddy and Rika Raja from the Uncharted series. Raja's Arcade also makes an appearance in The Last of Us: American Dreams.
